claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Tolazamide is a first-generation sulfonylurea that binds the beta-cell sulfonylurea receptor (ABCC8/Kir6.2) with low micromolar affinity, but at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled viability screen it is expected to produce little or no cytotoxicity, since its pharmacology is mediated by insulin secretagogue activity rather than direct cell killing.
